title: Rabbi Kiris of Irmah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 3:8, saying: “Whoever can protest and does not protest bears responsibility for the wrongdoing.” In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, end of chapter 5, the statement is attributed to Rabbi Kiris of Didmah.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat chapter 5 paragraph names Rabbi Kiris of Didmah and gives the responsibility-for-failing-to-protest saying. Hyman’s intended matching Beitzah 3:8 occurrence was not established by the bounded checks, including chapter routing; this is not an absence claim. His Irmah heading and Beitzah citation are retained beside the positively matched Shabbat form, without deciding whether these forms identify the same person.
